newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: No encouragement seen for flat Singapore shares.
newsitem.headline: No encouragement seen for flat Singapore shares.

text.p: With no encouraging signs to coax investors back to the market on Thursday, dealers were readying themselves for another quiet day.
"The market's moving only on the margins and there's not much of that to look forward to," a broker at a Singapore firm said.
Small capitalised and over-the-counter stocks were seen as the most likely targets for investors, with major fund managers expected to stick to the sidelines.
A fall of 13.33 points saw the Straits Times Industrials Index end Wednesday at 2,047.89, with little indication it would rally in the near future, dealers said.
An overnight correction on Wall Street, where the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 42.49 to 7,269.66, was seen as another negative factor for Singapore shares.
